sources.name: bunki-sites-v11 grammar patterns
sources.attribution: authored in-repo for bunki-sites-v11; harvested per #36

entries.mEn: an ongoing action or continuing state

ex.ja: 毎朝、日本語のラジオを聞いている。
ex.en: I listen to Japanese radio every morning.

entries.mEn: want to do

ex.ja: この表現を会話で使ってみたい。
ex.en: I want to try using this expression in conversation.

entries.mEn: while doing; at the same time

ex.ja: 歩きながら長い動画を聞いた。
ex.en: I listened to a long video while walking.

entries.mEn: come to be able to; reach a new state

ex.ja: 同じ表現に再会すると、自然に使えるようになる。
ex.en: When you meet the same expression again, you become able to use it naturally.

entries.mEn: continue or change from now onward

ex.ja: 出会った言葉から、学びの道が分岐していく。
ex.en: The learning path branches outward from the words you encounter.

entries.mEn: by doing; through the fact that

ex.ja: 文脈ごと復習することで、言葉が使える知識になる。
ex.en: By reviewing the whole context, words become usable knowledge.

entries.mEn: not A, but B

ex.ja: 学びは単語の一覧ではなく、生きたつながりだ。
ex.en: Learning is not a list of words, but a living web of connections.

entries.mEn: so that; in such a way that

ex.ja: 忘れても戻れるように、元の文脈を残しておく。
ex.en: I preserve the original context so I can return even if I forget.

entries.mEn: it does not mean that; not necessarily
entries.form: plain form + わけではない

ex.ja: 一度理解したからといって、使えるわけではない。
ex.en: Understanding it once does not necessarily mean you can use it.

entries.mEn: as one thing changes, another changes with it
entries.form: noun / plain verb + につれて

ex.ja: 理解が深まるにつれて、気づくニュアンスも増える。
ex.en: As understanding deepens, the nuances you notice also increase.

entries.mEn: it is decided or comes about that

ex.ja: 今日の会話も、明日の復習に戻ってくることになる。
ex.en: Today's conversation will also come back in tomorrow's review.

entries.mEn: according to; in response to

ex.ja: 理解度に応じて、次に読む素材を変える。
ex.en: Change the next material according to your comprehension.

entries.mEn: after doing; in the process of
entries.form: past verb / noun の + 上で

ex.ja: 原文を理解した上で、別の文脈へ移す。
ex.en: After understanding the original, move it into another context.

entries.mEn: without doing

ex.ja: 元の出典を失うことなく、文をカードに変える。
ex.en: Turn the sentence into a card without losing its original source.

entries.mEn: although; even though

ex.ja: 六割は理解したものの、知らない表現がまだ多かった。
ex.en: Although I understood sixty percent, there were still many unknown expressions.

entries.mEn: cannot avoid doing; have no choice but to
entries.form: negative verb stem + ざるを得ない

ex.ja: 文脈がなければ、訳だけに頼らざるを得ない。
ex.en: Without context, you have no choice but to rely only on translation.

entries.mEn: nothing more than; merely
entries.form: noun / plain form + にすぎない

ex.ja: 試験の級は、現在地を示す一つの目印にすぎない。
ex.en: A test level is merely one marker showing your present position.

entries.mEn: far from; not only not A, but B
entries.form: noun / plain form + どころか

ex.ja: 忘れるどころか、別の文脈でも自然に使えた。
ex.en: Far from forgetting it, I could use it naturally in another context.

entries.mEn: all the way to; even reaching

ex.ja: 単語から話し方の癖に至るまで、素材の痕跡を残す。
ex.en: Preserve traces of the material, from its words all the way to its speaking habits.

entries.mEn: starting with; using as the beginning

ex.ja: 一つの動画を皮切りに、関連する一次資料へ広げていく。
ex.en: Starting with one video, branch out into related primary sources.

entries.mEn: there is no need to; it goes without saying

ex.ja: すべてを暗記するまでもない。必要な糸だけを育てればいい。
ex.en: There is no need to memorize everything; grow only the threads you need.

entries.mEn: not even one; not for even

ex.ja: 出典の一行たりとも、勝手に自分の記憶として扱わない。
ex.en: Do not treat even one line of a source as your own content without permission.

entries.mEn: cannot help but cause; will inevitably
entries.form: negative verb stem + ずにはおかない

ex.ja: 本物の物語は、学ぶ人の心を動かさずにはおかない。
ex.en: A genuine story inevitably moves the learner's heart.

entries.mEn: cannot suppress a feeling
entries.form: emotion noun + を禁じ得ない

ex.ja: 再び自然に聞き取れた瞬間、喜びを禁じ得なかった。
ex.en: At the moment I could understand it naturally again, I could not suppress my joy.
